subject.title: feat: per-channel debounce/cap/drop queue options (mode already supported)

question: Which public config shape should per-channel queue cap/drop use now that `messages.queue.byChannel` is a mode map and `messages.queue.debounceMsByChannel` already exists?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the originally suggested nested `byChannel` object conflicts with the shipped mode-map contract, and OpenClaw policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add explicit cap/drop maps
options.body: Add separate `capByChannel` and `dropByChannel`-style maps while leaving `byChannel` and `debounceMsByChannel` compatible with existing configs.

options.title: Redesign `byChannel` with migration
options.body: Move to nested per-channel option objects only with an explicit doctor migration and docs for the shipped string-map shape.

options.title: Keep cap/drop global or session-scoped
options.body: Decline the config expansion and document global defaults plus `/queue` session overrides as the supported cap/drop controls.

recommendation.title: Add explicit cap/drop maps
recommendation.body: Add separate `capByChannel` and `dropByChannel`-style maps while leaving `byChannel` and `debounceMsByChannel` compatible with existing configs.

likelyOwner.reason: They added the current per-channel debounce surface and have the strongest recent history in the queue config/runtime contract.
